title: Approximation of differential entropy in Bayesian optimal experimental design
abstract: arXiv:2510.00734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bayesian optimal experimental design provides a principled framework for selecting experimental configurations that maximize obtained information. In this work, we consider settings where the likelihood entropy is independent of the design or can be evaluated explicitly, which applies, e.g. to additive noise models with design-independent or explicitly computable noise entropy. This reduces the problem to maximum entropy estimation, where the nested integral defining the expected information gain collapses into a single integral.   Our study is motivated by large-scale inference problems, such as inverse problems, where the computational cost is dominated by expensive likelihood evaluations. translated_title: 贝叶斯最优实验设计中微分熵的近似
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯最优实验设计为选择能够最大化所获信息的实验配置提供了一个原则性框架。在本工作中，我们考虑似然熵与设计无关或可被显式计算的情形，这适用于例如具有设计无关或可显式计算噪声熵的加性噪声模型。这将问题简化为最大熵估计，其中定义期望信息增益的嵌套积分塌缩为单个积分。我们的研究受到大规模推断问题（如逆问题）的启发，此类问题的计算成本主要由昂贵的似然评估所主导。在加性高斯噪声模型下，我们提出了一种计算方法：证据密度由蒙特卡洛或拟蒙特卡洛代理进行近似，而微分熵则使用标准方法进行评估，无需……
tldr: 该论文针对贝叶斯最优实验设计提出了一种高效计算方法：当似然熵与设计无关或可显式计算时，期望信息增益的嵌套积分可简化为单积分，并通过蒙特卡洛或拟蒙特卡洛代理近似证据密度来高效估计微分熵。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient computational approach for Bayesian optimal experimental design, in which the nested integral for expected information gain collapses into a single integral when the likelihood entropy is design-independent or explicitly computable, and the differential entropy is estimated by approximating the evidence density with Monte Carlo or quasi-Monte Carlo surrogates.
